name: Watchtower

retired.note: No longer offered: archived by its maintainers and incompatible with current Docker; unattended updates are not recommended. Existing Watchtower containers are still recognized; nothing is removed.

deprecationNote: Archived by its maintainers (December 2025); last release v1.7.1 (2023). It fails against current Docker Engines ("client version 1.25 is too old") and needs full Docker socket access to recreate containers unattended.
description: Legacy automatic container updater. Listed for reference only: unattended updates are disabled in this manager.
installNote: Not installable: unmaintained and incompatible with current Docker. Use What's Up Docker (notifications) and Installed apps > Updates (backup, preview, confirmation) instead.
